chip.description: L7A0498 graphics controller: three scrolling tile layers (background, foreground and text), a sprite engine with 8x8 to 128x128 variable-size double-buffered sprites, and the /HSYNC, /VSYNC and /BLANK outputs with a scanline counter — the whole video system of Toaplan 2 hardware (taxonomy V1).
chip.notes: src/mame/toaplan/gp9001.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Toaplan L7A0498 GP9001 graphic controller"), whose video status register documents the /H-Sync, /V-Sync and /Blank control signals and the scanline count. Some boards fit two of them, mixed by a motherboard PAL.
